79–'85
is the first
greatest hits
album by New Zealand
new wave
band
Mi-Sex
, released in October 1985. The album included tracks from the band's four studio albums and some previously released non-album singles. A limited released of 5000 copies included a bonus 12" medley.
'
79–'85
peaked at number 46 on the Australian
